# 🧩 AI Agent Skills & Extensions Directory

![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-blue) ![entries](https://img.shields.io/badge/entries-13-green) ![open%20source](https://img.shields.io/badge/open%20source-5-brightgreen) ![categories](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-3-purple) [![CI](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/ai-agent-skills-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/ai-agent-skills-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

> A curated, machine-readable directory of the **skill / extension ecosystems** that extend what AI agents & assistants can do — open skill/tool protocols, platform skill systems from the major providers, and skill/agent marketplaces.

Distinct from a list of individual tools (see *agent tools*) or code SDKs (see *agent frameworks*): this catalogs the *systems, protocols, and marketplaces* themselves. New and fast-moving — curated conservatively.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -e .                # stdlib-only; no runtime deps
skill-dir list                  # list all
skill-dir list --open-source    # only open protocols/systems
skill-dir list --category platform_skills
skill-dir search mcp            # search name/org/note/tags
skill-dir export --format csv > skills.csv
skill-dir generate              # regenerate this README
```

## At a glance

- **13** entries across **3** categories
- 🟢 **5** open · 🔒 **8** proprietary

## Design and motion resources

The [design and motion guide](resources/design-motion.md) introduces the individual skills and tools. Browse their upstream links, licenses and tags in the [companion CSV](resources/design-motion.csv) or search it with `skill-dir resources`.

```bash
skill-dir resources animation --kind skill
skill-dir resources --kind tool --format json
```

The [creative discovery guide](resources/creative-discovery.md) covers places to find more projects. Browse the [source catalog](resources/creative-discovery.csv) or run `skill-dir sources` to list them all. Use `skill-dir sources --has-feed --format json` for sources with a feed URL.

## Directory

### Platform Skill Systems (8)

| Name | Org | Source | License | Notes |
|------|-----|--------|---------|-------|
| [Amazon Bedrock Agents](https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/agents/) | AWS | 🔒 Proprietary | Proprietary | Agents with action groups (skills) backed by Lambda/APIs. |
| [Anthropic Agent Skills](https://www.anthropic.com) | Anthropic | 🔒 Proprietary | Proprietary | Composable Skills (instructions + optional scripts) that extend Claude for tasks. |
| [Gemini CLI extensions](https://geminicli.com/docs/extensions/) | Google | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | Packages skills, commands, and MCP servers as shareable extensions for Gemini CLI. |
| [Google Gemini Gems](https://gemini.google.com) | Google | 🔒 Proprietary | Proprietary | Custom 'Gems' that tailor Gemini for specific, repeatable tasks. |
| [Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com) | Microsoft | 🔒 Proprietary | Proprietary | Build custom copilots/agents with skills, topics, and connectors. |
| [OpenAI GPTs & GPT Store](https://chatgpt.com/gpts) | OpenAI | 🔒 Proprietary | Proprietary | Custom GPTs (assistants + actions) built and shared via the GPT Store. |
| [OpenCode skills](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/) | Anomaly | 🟢 OSS | MIT | Discovers SKILL.md instructions in project and user directories and loads them on demand. |
| [Salesforce Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/) | Salesforce | 🔒 Proprietary | Proprietary | Platform for building agents with reusable actions/skills. |

### Skill & Tool Protocols (3)

| Name | Org | Source | License | Notes |
|------|-----|--------|---------|-------|
| [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/specification) | Agent Skills | 🟢 OSS | CC-BY-4.0 (spec), Apache-2.0 (code) | Defines how to package reusable instructions, scripts, and references around a SKILL.md file. |
| [Agent2Agent (A2A)](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/) | A2A Project | 🟢 OSS | Apache-2.0 | Agents publish skills in an Agent Card so other agents can discover them and delegate tasks. |
| [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) | Anthropic (open standard) | 🟢 OSS | MIT | Open standard for connecting agents to tools, data sources, and skills. |

## Contributing
